glosses: to move by pulling, to move by dragging

examples.translation: The murderer dragged the body into the woods.
examples.english: The murderer dragged the body into the woods.

glosses: to pull tight, to draw (e.g. curtains)

examples.translation: I will draw the blinds and go to bed.
examples.english: I will draw the blinds and go to bed.

glosses: to enlist, to conscript, to recruit

examples.text: Jego ojciec chciał zaciągnąć go do marynarki.
examples.translation: His father wanted to enlist him in the navy.
examples.english: His father wanted to enlist him in the navy.

glosses: to incur (e.g. a debt), to take out (e.g. a loan)

examples.text: Nie chce zaciągnąć pożyczki na dom.
examples.translation: He doesn't want to take out a loan against the house.
examples.english: He doesn't want to take out a loan against the house.

glosses: to drag, to force to go

examples.text: Musiałem go niemal zaciągnąć do szkoły.
examples.translation: I practically had to drag him to school.
examples.english: I practically had to drag him to school.

glosses: to enlist, to enrol, to join (e.g. the army)

examples.translation: I'm bored. Maybe I'll join the army.
examples.english: I'm bored. Maybe I'll join the army.

glosses: to take a drag, to inhale

examples.text: Czy mogę zaciągnąć się Twoim papierosem?
examples.translation: Can I take a drag on your cigarette?
examples.english: Can I take a drag on your cigarette?

examples.text: Chłopaki zaciągnęli go do kina, potem Pawełek zdobył bilety na recital Ewy Demarczyk, a potem był mecz hokejowy Polska – NRD, na który poszli całą gromadą i na przemian to wrzeszczeli, to dęli w trąbki, dopingując swojaków
